name: Bauladu (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bauladu (quartered with a red cross, a tower and other charges) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Bauladu, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bauladu arms — quartered with a red cross, a tower and other charges, crowned, within branches
